assertions.name: nuc11_chi111_equals_q_inv4_chi3
assertions.source: chi_{(1^3)}(Delta_nuc11) = q^{-4} * chi_{(3)}(Delta_nuc11) < 0 on both 11-letter words

assertions.name: nuc11_blocks_match_qbeta_utils_closed_forms
assertions.source: chi_{(3)}, chi_{(2,1)}, chi_{(1^3)} on census vectors match qbeta_utils closed forms to 50+ dps

assertions.name: lever_b_gpmt_pos_brackets_codata_on_11_crossing_words
assertions.source: GPMT+ moves nuc11_interleaved to 0.77033803 MeV (-1.5332%) and nuc11_gen_grouped to 0.78649174 MeV (+0.5315%), bracketing CODATA and restoring F_rem < 1 on nuc11_gen_grouped

assertions.name: lever_a_kd6_full_twist_restores_elliptic_cosine_reach_on_live_cell
assertions.source: 6-crossing full-twist KD character (q^6+q^-6)/2 = 1.2024503809 moves live cell base to 0.78382486 MeV (+0.1906%), restoring F_rem = 0.99809720 < 1; with N=1, N=2 & 2-term Borromean QED gives Q_beta = 0.78265186 MeV (0.04070%, m_n residual 0.3389 ppm)

description: 50-dps evaluation of the two active candidate mechanisms bridging the Convention D Q_beta ladder & base gap (qou-pdix -> qou-cds1): Lever A (Kohno-Drinfeld hyperbolic cosh(k*ln q) holonomy & 6-crossing full-twist framing (q^6+q^{-6})/2 on the ruled z_D base) and Lever B (GPMT (1^3) modified-trace completion of tr_M^{z_D} where w_{(1^3)}(z_D) = 0).

delta_S.description: Single-crossing linear generator element Delta_S = (h^2/2)*1 - (h/2)*(sigma_0 + sigma_1)

nuc11_interleaved.description: 11-crossing interleaved nucleon word difference build_atom_nf_exact(n) - build_atom_nf_exact(p) (LIVE SCORED Form-B cell)

nuc11_gen_grouped.description: 11-crossing generator-grouped nucleon word difference nucleon_gen_chains(n) - nucleon_gen_chains(p)

KD_k1_single_wrap.description: 1-crossing Kohno-Drinfeld hyperbolic character (q + q^{-1})/2 = cosh(ln q)

KD_k2_double_wrap.description: 2-crossing Kohno-Drinfeld hyperbolic character (q^2 + q^{-2})/2 = cosh(2 ln q)

KD_k3_half_twist.description: 3-crossing half-twist Delta_3 hyperbolic character (q^3 + q^{-3})/2 = cosh(3 ln q)

KD_k6_full_twist_framing.description: 6-crossing full-twist framing Delta_3^2 = (sigma_0*sigma_1*sigma_0)^2 character (q^6 + q^{-6})/2 = cosh(6 ln q)

caveats: Scope-(a) diagnostic and bridge probe for qou-pdix -> qou-cds1. All evaluated expressions are parameter-free functions of q_0 at the proton pin (zero fitted parameters, zero float64).
